pages.text: Outside the Overworld spawn refuge, an uncleared dimension tracks your presence. A top-screen bar counts toward the next escalation: Listening, Noticed, Hunted, Overrun, then Reckoning. Hunters carry the infection; exposure still

pages.text: The default frontier grants two quiet minutes, sends hunters after four, intensifies at seven, and calls a pursuing guardian after ten effective minutes. The Overworld clock runs at half speed; establishing a foothold halves it

pages.title: An answering pulse
pages.text: A checkpoint removes 45 seconds of attention. Leaving or resting in the spawn refuge cools it twice as fast as it rises. Logging out or dying does not reset it. A disruption charm prevents new infection, not the hunt.

pages.title: An answering pulse
pages.text: The survey’s dimensional pressure is a separate shared measure that strengthens expedition waves. The attention bar measures your personal exposure.
